name: Princess and Superhero Breakfast and Skate at Hanford Winter Wonderland
when_note: Saturday is the princess morning and Sunday is the superhero morning.
paras: The downtown Hanford ice rink hosts two character mornings on one weekend. Saturday brings princess characters to a breakfast followed by a private skating session, and Sunday swaps in costumed superheroes with a full buffet of pancakes, eggs and bacon, then skating.

The $25 ticket covers breakfast, skate rentals, the skating session, and a meet and greet with photos. The princess page invites kids to dress up and mentions autographs, and the superhero page says spaces are limited. Tickets are sold through Eventbrite.
tip: Reserve early on Eventbrite and have kids wear their costume over warm layers for the ice.
